transitions.guard: same fingerprint + remaining=1 + explicit seller-edit decisions

correction_state_machine.cancel_rule: Cancel before success preserves original usable draft and remaining=1.
correction_state_machine.terminal_rule: used exposes manual editing only; never a second automatic guided correction.

immutable_photo_set_fingerprint.algorithm: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 join of sorted lowercase SHA-256 content digests for every original source photo, separated by newline.
immutable_photo_set_fingerprint.order_semantics: Reordering or changing cover position does not change the fingerprint; add/remove/replace/content mutation does.
immutable_photo_set_fingerprint.capture: Persist the fingerprint on the original usable draft and correction eligibility record.
immutable_photo_set_fingerprint.apply_guard: Server recomputes the current photo-set fingerprint and requires exact equality before applying the included correction.
immutable_photo_set_fingerprint.mismatch: Keep the original draft and manual editing; explain that AI re-analysis of a changed photo set is a new complete run.

must_preserve: seller title when Keep is chosen
regeneration_boundary.manual_continuation: Unlimited manual identity, listing, price, and photo edits remain available without consuming another AI run or correction.
regeneration_boundary.new_photo_set: Manual photo replacement does not run AI. AI re-analysis of changed photos is a new complete run.
